Entity.name: Entity
Entity.description: Processes are dynamic, unfolding happenings that involve change, activity, or transformation over time.

children.name: Physical
children.description: An entity that is tangible, spatial, and has matter.

children.name: Animate
children.description: A physical entity that is living and sentient.

children.name: Person
children.description: A human being

children.name: Inanimate
children.description: A physical entity that is a non-living object or location.

children.name: Spatial_Geographic
children.description: Am inanimate entity that is a location.

children.name: Geo_Political_Entity
children.description: A geographical area governed by a specific political structure and possesses the authority to make decisions affecting its population and territory.

children.name: Location
children.description: Physical places, such as cities, countries, or landmarks.

children.name: Facility
children.description: A place, building, or piece of equipment established to serve a specific purpose or function.

children.name: Artifact
children.description: Am inanimate entity that is made by humans.

children.name: Product
children.description: Objects made by humans for sale or use.

children.name: Abstract
children.description: An entity that is intangible, conceptual, or social constructs

children.name: Social_And_Collective
children.description: An abstract entity that are groups or constructs of people.

children.name: Organization
children.description: Corporations, agencies, religious groups, political parties, academic institutions, and other formally organized bodies of people, excluding individual humans or physical buildings.

children.name: NORP
children.description: Identifies people or groups defined by their shared heritage, faith, or political affiliation, as well as the adjectival forms of these identities.

children.name: Nationality
children.description: The legal status or formal,,membership a person holds in a specific nation-state or country, usually acquired through birth, descent, or naturalization, which identifies them as a citizen of that country

children.name: Religious_Group
children.description: A collection of individuals united by shared beliefs, doctrines, practices, or rituals centered around a common faith or spiritual tradition.

children.name: Political_Group
children.description: Organized association of individuals, such as a political party or coalition, that shares similar ideological views, promotes specific policies, and works to influence government or win public office.

children.name: Temporal_And_Occurrence
children.description: An abstract entity for time-bound concepts.

children.name: Date
children.description: Absolute or relative points in time, as well as durations more than 24 hours.

children.name: Time
children.description: Specific points in time or durations that represent a period of less than 24 hours.

children.name: Value_And_Quantification
children.description: An abstract entity for measurements and numbers.

children.name: Money
children.description: Monetary values, including both the numerical amount and the specific currency unit or symbol.

children.name: Quantity
children.description: Measurements of physical dimensions such as weight, distance, area, or volume, typically expressed as a number followed by a unit.

children.name: Percent
children.description: Percentage values and ratios.

children.name: Cardinal
children.description: Numerals, whole numbers, or fractions that represent a count of items but do not fall into other specific categories like dates, times, or money.

children.name: Ordinal
children.description: Numbers that indicate a position or rank within a defined sequence rather than a quantity.

children.name: Intellectual_And_Systemic
children.description: An abstract entity for ideas, laws, and creations.

children.name: Work_Of_Art
children.description: Named titles of creative human productions, including books, movies, songs, television shows, paintings, and plays.

children.name: Law
children.description: Named legal documents, treaties, acts, or amendments that have been formally codified into law.

children.name: Language
children.description: Names of specific spoken or written languages and their dialects.

children.name: Digital_Identifier
children.description: A standardized sequence of characters or symbols used to uniquely reference, address, or categorize an entity, resource, or concept within a specific digital namespace or protocol.

children.name: Handle
children.description: A unique alphanumeric identifier, typically prefixed by a specific symbol (such as '@'), representing a specific user account, persona, or organization within a social platform or communication system.

children.name: Tag
children.description: A string of characters, typically prefixed by a symbol (such as '#'), acting as a non-hierarchical keyword or metadata label assigned to information to describe its topic, theme, or context.

children.name: Locator
children.description: A structured character string that functions as a reference to a web resource, specifying its location on a computer network and a mechanism for retrieving it.
